title: Dead-Time Compensator
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Signal Management/Dead_Time_Compensator.md
text: 通过修改参考电压克服死区时间效应，输入 5 路、输出 1 路；{Dead time (s)} 指定逆变器开关死区时间 1e-6、{Enable hysteresis for currents near zero-crossing} 为过零附近电流启用滞环算法、{Current hysteresis band (A)} 指定过零附近的电流滞环带、{Motor current input} 指定电机电流输入的类型 Two currents、{Show enable port} 启用输入端口，按实例取值。

ports.name: Enable
ports.summary: 用于使能模块输出的信号 scalar

ports.name: V abc ± Δ
ports.summary: 补偿后的三相电压 scalar

params.name: Dead time (s)
params.values: 逆变器开关死区时间 1e-6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Enable hysteresis for currents near zero-crossing
params.values: 为过零附近电流启用滞环算法的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Current hysteresis band (A)
params.values: 过零附近的电流滞环带 0.1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Motor current input
params.values: 电机电流输入的类型 Two currents (Ia,Ib) (default) | Three currents (Ia,Ib,Ic)

params.values: 启用输入端口的选项 off (default) | on
